title: Retail Fixed Deposit Interest Rates
content: Retail fixed deposit rates for deposits below INR 2 crore effective 2026-04-01: 7 to 14 days regular 3.50% senior citizen 4.00%; 15 to 45 days regular 4.00% senior citizen 4.50%; 46 to 179 days regular 5.25% senior citizen 5.75%; 180 days to less than 1 year regular 6.25% senior citizen 6.75%; 1 year to less than 2 years regular 6.80% senior citizen 7.30%; 2 years to less than 3 years regular 7.10% senior citizen 7.60%; 3 years to 5 years regular 6.90% senior citizen 7.40%. Senior citizen benefit is an additional 0.50% over the regular rate for eligible resident senior citizens. Staff must confirm the live CBS rate card before booking.
